shortDescription: A free bonus course that shows you how to set up on Fiverr, write gigs buyers find and grow from your first order to steady work.
description:
This freelancing course shows you how to turn the skills you are learning into paid work on Fiverr, one of the largest marketplaces for freelance services.

Thousands of Nigerians earn in foreign currency by selling design, writing, video, development and data services online. The skill itself is only half the job: buyers have to find you, trust you and choose you over hundreds of other sellers. This short course covers that second half. It comes free with every SkillsAir programme, so you can start building your freelance presence while you learn.

## What the freelancing course covers

- **Introduction.** How Fiverr works for buyers and sellers, the kinds of services that sell and what to expect in your first months.
- **A professional profile.** Choosing a username, writing a description that builds trust, a profile photo that looks professional and adding skills, education and certificates.
- **Fiverr SEO.** How Fiverr search ranks gigs, finding the words buyers actually type and placing them naturally in titles, tags and descriptions.
- **A gig that sells.** Titles, packages and pricing tiers, gig images and video, descriptions, FAQs and requirements that set clear expectations.
- **Your first steps as a new seller.** Staying active on the platform, replying to messages quickly and politely, delivering on time, and avoiding the common mistakes that get new accounts restricted.
- **Two growth strategies.** Practical approaches for increasing orders and income once you have your first reviews, including offering extras and building repeat clients.
- **Conclusion.** Putting it together into a weekly routine you can keep alongside your studies or job.

## How the freelancing course works

The course is short and practical. Each lesson ends with an action to take on your own profile, so by the time you finish you have a profile and at least one gig live. A short quiz at the end of the main chapters checks the key ideas, with an explanation for every answer. Because it is a bonus, there is no final exam or certificate for this course; it supports the programme you are studying.

## Why it matters alongside your main programme

Freelancing is often the fastest way to get real experience with real clients. A data analysis learner can offer spreadsheet clean-up, a graphic design learner can offer logos and social posts, a web development learner can offer landing pages and a videographer can offer short promotional edits. Each completed order adds a review, a portfolio piece and income, and each one makes the next client easier to win. You can start small while you are still learning and grow your offer as your skills improve.

## Who it is for

This course is for every SkillsAir learner who wants to earn from their new skills, whether as a side income or a full-time freelance business. It also suits people who already have a skill but have struggled to get noticed on Fiverr.

## What you need

You need a Fiverr account, which is free to create, a phone or computer and a skill you can offer, even at an early stage. Fiverr has its own rules on identity verification and payments, and the course explains how to set up your account so it stays in good standing.

## After you finish

You will have a complete profile, at least one well-written gig and a weekly routine for staying visible and responding to buyers. Results depend on your skill, effort and the market, so there are no income promises, but you will be following the same approach successful sellers use.

Every SkillsAir programme includes this course at no extra cost, and you can return to it whenever you add a new service.

faq.question: Is this course free?
faq.answer: Yes. It is a bonus included with every SkillsAir programme at no extra cost.

faq.question: Does it have an exam or certificate?
faq.answer: No. It has short quizzes after the main chapters, but no final exam or certificate because it supports your main programme.

faq.question: Is it only about Fiverr?
faq.answer: Yes, the lessons focus on Fiverr. Many of the ideas, such as clear service descriptions and fast responses, also help on other platforms.

faq.question: Can I start freelancing before I finish my main programme?
faq.answer: Yes. Start with small, simple services you can already deliver well and add more as your skills grow.

faq.question: Will I make money straight away?
faq.answer: There are no income promises. Results depend on your skill, effort and the market, but the course shows you the habits that help new sellers win their first orders.
